privacy.title: Privacy Policy
sections: Who we are

This policy describes how [LEGAL BUSINESS NAME], operating as Texas Home Outlet, handles information through this website for our manufactured and modular home retail business in Huffman, Texas. Mailing address: [MAILING ADDRESS]. Contact email: [CONTACT EMAIL]. Effective date: [EFFECTIVE DATE].
Information we collect

When you request information, use a lead form, chat with us, or book an appointment, we may collect your name, phone number, email address, messages, home preferences, and appointment details. We may also collect technical information such as IP address, browser information, pages visited, referral sources, and cookies or similar browser storage.
How we use information

We use information to answer questions, follow up on home inquiries, arrange showroom visits, provide customer service, maintain records, protect the website, and understand how visitors use it. Providing contact details lets our team respond to your request. Any separate marketing choices should be explained when they are offered.
AI chat assistant

Our chat assistant uses AI to help answer questions and gather inquiry or appointment details. Messages may be processed by technology providers supporting the assistant and reviewed by our team. AI answers can be incomplete or incorrect. Confirm pricing, availability, financing, and appointment details with a staff member. Do not enter Social Security numbers, bank details, passwords, or other sensitive information in chat.
Service providers and sharing

We may share information with providers that help operate hosting, communications, appointment booking, customer records, AI chat, and analytics. We may also disclose information when required by law or to protect people and our business. If you ask us to connect you with a lender or another partner, we will explain the information needed for that referral.
Cookies and analytics

The website uses browser storage for features such as chat sessions and preferences. We may use analytics to understand visits and improve the site. Where optional analytics controls are shown, you can allow or decline those tools and update your choice through the site controls. Browser settings can also limit cookies or storage, though some features may stop working.
Retention and security

We keep information for as long as needed to handle inquiries, provide services, maintain business records, and meet legal obligations. Retention depends on the information and purpose. We use safeguards intended to protect information, but no website or transmission method is completely secure.
Your choices and requests

You can choose not to submit a form or use chat. To ask about your information, request a correction or deletion, or ask us to stop contacting you, email [CONTACT EMAIL] or write to [MAILING ADDRESS]. We may need to verify your identity and may retain records required by law. Available rights depend on applicable law.
Children and other websites
This website is intended for adult home shoppers. Please do not submit information about children. Links to lenders, manufacturers, or other websites have their own privacy practices.
Changes and contact
We may update this policy and will show the revised effective date here. For questions, contact [LEGAL BUSINESS NAME] at [CONTACT EMAIL] or [MAILING ADDRESS].

terms.title: Terms of Use
sections: About these terms

These terms cover use of the Texas Home Outlet website operated by [LEGAL BUSINESS NAME], a manufactured and modular home retailer in Huffman, Texas. Mailing address: [MAILING ADDRESS]. Contact email: [CONTACT EMAIL]. Effective date: [EFFECTIVE DATE]. By using this website, you agree to these terms.
Home information and pricing

Listings, photos, floorplans, dimensions, features, prices, and availability are provided for general information and may change. Photos may show optional features or model homes. Confirm the exact home, included features, total price, taxes, delivery, setup, site work, permits, and utility costs with our team. Website information is not a binding offer or sales contract.
Financing and purchase agreements

Financing information and payment estimates are examples, not loan approvals or guaranteed terms. Lender approval and individual circumstances affect financing. A home purchase, deposit, delivery, warranty, or financing arrangement is governed by the separate written agreements and disclosures you receive. These website terms do not replace those agreements or limit rights provided by law.
AI chat and appointments

The AI assistant can make mistakes and does not provide legal, tax, or financial advice. Confirm important details with a staff member. An appointment request does not reserve a home or guarantee availability. Contact our team to confirm, change, or cancel a visit.
Responsible use

Provide accurate information that you are authorized to share. Do not submit sensitive financial or identity information through general forms or chat. Do not misuse the website, attempt unauthorized access, upload harmful content, or interfere with other visitors.
Website content and outside links

Website text, images, branding, and other materials belong to their respective owners. You may use the site for personal home shopping, but may not reuse materials commercially without permission. Third-party websites and services have their own terms, and we do not control their content or decisions.
Availability and limitations

We aim to keep the website helpful and accurate, but cannot guarantee uninterrupted access or error-free information. To the extent permitted by applicable law, we are not responsible for losses caused by reliance on website errors or interruptions. Nothing in these terms excludes obligations or consumer rights that cannot lawfully be excluded.
Privacy
Our Privacy Policy explains how we handle lead forms, chat messages, appointment information, and website usage information. Contact [CONTACT EMAIL] with questions about your information.
Changes and questions
We may update these terms and show the revised effective date here. For questions about the website or these terms, contact [LEGAL BUSINESS NAME] at [CONTACT EMAIL] or [MAILING ADDRESS].
